items.prompt: A long table covered with old books and manuscripts from many traditions, open on top of each other in layers: scrolls, bound codices, palm-leaf pages, a worn notebook on top; a lamp and a magnifying glass; two people bending over them at the edge of the light.

alt.ru: Длинный стол, заваленный старыми книгами и рукописями разных традиций, раскрытыми слоями: свитки, кодексы, пальмовые листы, сверху потрёпанный блокнот; лампа и лупа.
alt.en: A long table covered in old books and manuscripts of many traditions open in layers: scrolls, codices, palm-leaf pages, a worn notebook on top; a lamp and a magnifier.
alt.pt: Uma longa mesa coberta de livros e manuscritos antigos de muitas tradições, abertos em camadas: rolos, códices, folhas de palmeira, um caderno gasto por cima; candeeiro e lupa.
alt.es: Una larga mesa cubierta de libros y manuscritos antiguos de muchas tradiciones abiertos en capas: rollos, códices, hojas de palma, un cuaderno gastado encima; lámpara y lupa.
